messages:
Marie: Quick kickoff—finalize CTA phasing + inbound routing for the launch newsletter this Thu. Goals: installs → trial → demo. Who owns routing rules?
Alex: I got CTA phasing. Plan: phased CTAs by cohort window: W1: "Read benchmark" (content), W2: "Start trial", W3: "Book demo". Variant B surfaces trial in W1 for high-engagers. :rocket:
Marie: Alex, add a timing matrix with send windows + cohort cutoffs. Avoid midnight APAC sends.
Olivia: Noted. Also: legal/consent check for EU/UK recipients—we had that suppression edge-case in last audit.
Samir: Inbound routing rules proposal: initial replies → support queue (48h SLA). Any reply or click showing intent -> tag and route to SDRs. Regex for reply intent: /(demo|trial|pricing|interested)/i
Samir: Example pseudo-rule:
```
if (event == "cta_click" && cta_id == "trial") {
  tag = "trial_click"
  route = "sdr_inbox"
}
if (reply_text =~ /demo|trial|pricing|interested/i) {
  tag = "reply_intent"
  route = "sdr_inbox"
}
```
Alex: Ops—can you map these to Braze/HubSpot event names? Proposed: newsletter.send.v3, newsletter.cta.click.trial.v1, newsletter.reply.v1
Ops: Will confirm event names and push to tracking plan. Also will provide enterprise G2B list for high-value routing.
Olivia: Suggest gating trial CTA for low-engagers: only show trial in W2 if open_rate_W1 >= 18% OR clicked_link_W1. That improves trial-to-paid conversion.
Alex: I'll implement gating in the variant logic and include a fallback CTA to read more for low-engagers.
Marie: We need subject line A/B and three preview texts. MKT copy due EOD Tue.
Olivia: I'll own subject lines + previews. Drafts:
S-A: "New inference benchmarks — try it free"
S-B: "Reduce inference cost 2x — start a free trial"
Previews: "See real-world latency & cost numbers.", "Benchmarks + 7-day free trial inside.", "How teams cut inference spend by half."
Marie: Add APAC-friendly variants (no timezones, no currency mentions).
Samir: Automation addendum: route any inbound mentioning enterprise account names to enterprise SDRs. Ops to supply suppression/opt-out list to avoid outreach mistakes.
Alex: HTML asks: include 2-line benchmark blurb and 3 stat bullets (latency, cost, throughput) in the header. Keep it compact for mobile.
Olivia: Creative notes: keep preview text <90 chars. Use plain CTA buttons for accessibility. Provide alt text for images.
Ops: Confirmed suppression list will be exported by EOD tomorrow. Also will create tracking events and Braze attribute keys: is_high_engager, cohort_window, cta_variant.
Marie: Next steps recap: Alex = CTA/timing matrix + variant logic + gating rules. Olivia = subject lines + preview variants + creative notes. Ops = event names, suppression list, enterprise list. Samir = routing regex and SDR routing mapping.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "Launch newsletter sync" Thu 09:00 PT — attendees: Marie, Alex, Olivia, Samir, Ops
Marie: Thanks team. We'll review final QA Wed morning. :thumbsup:
